description:
## Why
```
for _ <- 1..3 do
  IO.inspect(:x)
end
```
fails with parse/expected-token: unexpected item without a newline: Underscore at 1:5. Elixir prints :x three times. Found in fixture 01115's oracle twin. Related but distinct: fz-sc8.91 (a def head whose operands are both underscores).

## What changes
An underscore is a generator pattern in a for comprehension, as any other pattern is.

## Signal
A new fixture with the program above passes on all three paths, oracle-checked.
